Elden Ring early-game Samurai stat allocation

Game: Elden Ring.

In Elden Ring, an early-game Samurai using an Uchigatana can level Vigor first for more health in solo PvE. The starting Samurai already meets the Uchigatana requirements, so early stat allocation can focus on surviving mistakes in Limgrave. Raising Vigor before investing heavily in damage stats is a simple survival recommendation, not an optimal damage-build or current-meta claim. This guidance concerns the base game and does not require DLC.
